example : Function.Bijective (fun x : ℝ => 2 * x + 1) := by
  constructor
  · intro a b h
    simp only at h
    linarith
  · intro y
    use (y - 1) / 2
    ring

example : (fun y : ℝ => (y - 1) / 2) ∘ (fun x : ℝ => 2 * x + 1) = id := by
  funext x
  simp
